newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says buys 50,000 T French SRW at $140.50.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says buys 50,000 T French SRW at $140.50.

text.p: Egypt's main commodities buyer said on Monday he bought 50,000 tonnes of soft red French wheat for $140.50 per tonne for delivery between April 1 and April 31.
Samir Shakankiri, vice chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters he bought the wheat from shippers Louis Dreyfus.
On Sunday, Shakankiri bought 450,000 tonnes of French wheat at prices ranging from $140.70 to $143.90 fob. He had originally tendered for 50,000 tonnes.
